Rebase Fan Chart Data

Source: R/utils_plot.R
rebase_fan_data.Rd

Scales the level bands with the same factor that rebase() applies to the level series, so that the fan stays aligned with the rebased level line.

Usage

rebase_fan_data(fan_data, level_mts, start, end)

Arguments

fan_data

A data frame as returned by build_fan_data().

level_mts

Level series (before rebasing) with one column per variable in fan_data.

start

Start date of the index period.

end

End date of the index period.

Value

fan_data with rebased lower and upper values.
